faq_page.title: Frequently asked questions
faq_page.subtitle: Everything you need to know about BookActivities
faq_page.t_a1: Choose the activity, pick a date and number of participants, and send your request. The provider will contact you to confirm the details, and you pay them directly.
faq_page.t_q2: Do I have to pay online?
faq_page.t_a2: No. BookActivities doesn't process activity payments. You pay the provider directly, whether in cash, bank transfer or another method they offer.
faq_page.t_q3: How do I cancel a booking?
faq_page.t_a3: Contact the provider directly following their cancellation policy, which is clearly shown on each activity. You can find the provider's contact details from your dashboard.
faq_page.t_a4: All providers publishing activities on BookActivities go through a verification process. However, BookActivities acts as an intermediary and doesn't organize the activities directly.
faq_page.p_q1: How much does it cost to list activities?
faq_page.p_a1: You need a monthly or annual subscription. Plans range from €49/month (Basic) to €199/month (Premium). You get a 30-day free trial when you sign up.
faq_page.p_q2: What happens if I don't pay the subscription?
faq_page.p_a2: If your subscription expires without renewing, your activities are automatically suspended and stop appearing on the marketplace. They're reactivated once you renew payment.
faq_page.p_a3: The platform commission is 5% of each booking's price. Additionally, if the booking comes from a partner hotel, there's an extra 8% commission for that hotel, which you pay when the booking is completed.
faq_page.p_a4: You'll get notifications of new bookings in your dashboard. You can confirm or decline each booking from there. The customer receives an automatic notification.
faq_page.h_q1: How does the affiliate system work?
faq_page.h_a1: When you register as a hotel you get a unique code and link. When your guests use that link to book, the booking is attributed to your hotel and you earn an 8% commission.
faq_page.h_q2: How do I get the QR code?
faq_page.h_a2: Once you register and complete your profile, a personalized QR code is generated automatically, which you can download and print for your reception desk.
faq_page.h_q3: When do I get paid commissions?
faq_page.h_a3: Commissions accrue monthly. You can request payment from your dashboard once you reach the minimum threshold, or at the end of each month.

legal_terms.title: Terms and conditions
legal_terms.notice: ⚠️ Important notice: BookActivities acts exclusively as a technology intermediary. It does not organise tourist activities, does not collect payments on behalf of providers, and accepts no liability for the provision of services, which rests solely with the registered providers.
legal_terms.s1_title: 1. Purpose and nature of the service
legal_terms.s1_p1: BookActivities is a technology intermediation platform that connects tourists (users) with providers of tourist activities. The platform does NOT provide tourist services directly.
legal_terms.s1_p2: Providers are independent companies or professionals who offer and manage their own activities. They are solely responsible for the quality, safety, legality and delivery of the activities offered.
legal_terms.s2_title: 2. Registration and use of the platform
legal_terms.s2_p1: Registration is required to access certain features of the platform. Users guarantee that the data they provide is accurate and undertake to keep it up to date.
legal_terms.s2_p2: There are three account types: customer (tourist), activity provider and partner hotel, each with its own terms of use.
legal_terms.s3_p1: Providers must hold an active monthly or annual subscription to publish activities and receive bookings. Without an active subscription, the provider’s activities are suspended automatically.
legal_terms.s3_p2: Subscription payments are processed through Stripe. In case of non-payment, BookActivities reserves the right to suspend the provider’s access to the services.
legal_terms.s4_p1: Bookings made through BookActivities are requests sent directly to the provider. <bold>BookActivities does not process activity payments</bold>. Payment for the activity is made directly to the provider under its own conditions.
legal_terms.s4_p2: BookActivities receives a 5% commission on the price of each confirmed booking, paid by the provider. Partner hotels receive an 8% commission on bookings generated through their links or QR codes.
legal_terms.s5_p1: BookActivities is not liable for any damage, loss or incident that may occur during activities. Responsibility for delivering the service lies entirely with the provider. Users should verify that the provider complies with all applicable tourism and safety regulations.
legal_terms.s6_p1: These terms are governed by Spanish law. For the resolution of disputes, the parties submit to the Courts of Torrevieja, Alicante, unless applicable regulations establish a different jurisdiction.
